name: Statutory withdrawal-button wording in all 24 official EU languages
description: The button wording Article 11a of Directive 2011/83/EU (as inserted by Directive (EU) 2023/2673) prescribes, read from the official EUR-Lex language versions rather than translated, with form-field labels rendering the three items of information Art. 11a(2) requires. The Directive prescribes no wording for the fields, so those labels are not quotations. Each language version of the Directive is equally authentic, so the button wording genuinely differs per language.

verification.method: both button labels refetched from their own official EUR-Lex language version and matched verbatim, by scripts/verify-statutory-labels.py; the field labels are renderings and are not checked against the text

DE.wording_allowance: oder einer anderen gleichbedeutenden eindeutigen Formulierung
DE.acknowledgement: unverzüglich auf einem dauerhaften Datenträger, mit dem Inhalt der Erklärung sowie Datum und Uhrzeit des Eingangs (Abs. 4)

AT.acknowledgement: auf einem dauerhaften Datenträger, mit dem Inhalt der Erklärung sowie Datum und Uhrzeit des Eingangs (Abs. 5)

license.terms: Free to reuse, including commercially, with attribution.
license.corrections: If a row is wrong, tell us and we will fix it here and say what was wrong, so every copy can be corrected from one place.

disclaimer: This reproduces the wording of official texts. It is not legal advice, and whether a given contract carries a right of withdrawal is a separate question (in Germany, see § 312g(2) BGB).
